decision: Select dungeon when matching; each human walks to the entrance and manually enters. The complete matched NPC cohort enters together with the party leader. A nonleader may enter earlier without NPCs. Invitations and matching acceptance do not teleport humans.
scope: Internal partial-occupancy composition, successive arrivals and atomic group/claim transfers. Public gateway/browser entry orchestration remains incomplete.

tests.goldenScenarios: All five complete state/RNG/reward captures unchanged; only fixture version metadata updated

verified: Planned five-person roster is separate from present units, controllers and human assets
A nonleader enters alone and does not gain leadership; the leader brings the full NPC cohort, whether entering first or later
Missing/early NPC cohorts are rejected; subsequent human arrivals do not count NPC participation again
Planned multiplayer rooms cannot use personal lifecycle authority while only the leader is present
Three successive humans, larger arriving simulation clock, preserved dungeon progress/RNG and remaining periodic timers
Every prior controller retains its own rebased input receipts; JSON restore and uninterrupted continuation agree
Incoming humans pass normal entrance rules; wrong entrance, malformed roster, duplicate identity, missing controller and combat arrivals are rejected without source mutation
Real Worker plus MemoryStore/PGlite cover together/separate manual arrivals, first/later transfer rollback after writes, duplicate submissions, old-owner fencing and persisted target recovery
Participant presentations share room context while retaining private character data
No new consistency table, external message queue or per-tick database operation
limitations: NPCs still belong to human aggregates. The verified independent-arrival flow uses the leader-owned NPC cohort. NPCs held by another still-travelling human need claim/state separation before they can accompany the leader without moving that human
Public manual-entry orchestration, gateway/browser route changes, NPC selection/bench handling and departure splitting are not connected
Joining requires an idle, alive boundary with no combat, casts, ground effects or pending group loot
The internal owner/routing instance ID changes during transfer; the dungeon run identity and progress are preserved
PGlite is SQL transaction coverage, not real PostgreSQL multi-connection failure/capacity evidence
No current browser crash, full shared encounter or loot-distribution acceptance in this iteration
